meta.task: Fix List #62 — Complete second-source pricing of every missing hole across all 33 albums (A001-A033) from a different price guide than the original file
base_files: collection/prices/wants_values_muse_20261015-0325.json (A017-A033, 558 valid holes after removing phantom A033 1936 Dot)
meta.second_source_policy: Strict second-source rule: Where Grok/Muse used Numista, Hobbizine, SpruceCrafts, CoinValueChecker, CoinValueApp, 1981sba, WorldCoinsInfo, FindRareCoins, APMEX, Greysheet, JMBullion, Collectons, or un-URL'd text, we price from USA Coin Book (https://www.usacoinbook.com/). Where Muse used USA Coin Book or CoinsAndCanada, we price from Numista (https://en.numista.com/). Every item includes both its independent second-source price ('value_usd') and the Fix List #62 reconciliation ('reconciled_high_usd': if sources differ by >25%, the higher value is recorded alongside both sources).
excluded_non_holes: A002 2019-W (printed mint-set circle, not a hole)
A004 1996-W (printed mint-set circle, not a hole)
A007 1970-D (printed mint-set circle, not a hole)
A013 2020-W (printed mint-set circle, not a hole)
A016 1982-D Cu small date (phantom slot — never minted and not present in physical Whitman #9033 folder)
A033 1936 Dot (phantom slot — not present in physical Whitman #9061 folder; removes $182,500 distortion)
meta.melt_floor: Silver never below melt: xag_usd 60.949001 (ASW oz: dime $4.41, quarter $11.02, half 90% $22.05, half 40% $9.01, wartime nickel $3.43, silver dollar $47.14).
